_comment: User-tunable defaults. Conservative on purpose. Copy this file, edit the copy, and pass it with -ConfigPath. Policy that governs what is allowed at all lives in policies.json, not here.

Scanning._comment: Age thresholds stop the toolkit proposing deletion of files an application is actively using. Scan budgets keep a single directory from monopolising the run.

Risk._comment: MaximumAutoApprovableRisk is the ceiling for the batch-approval option in the interactive plan. Anything at or above RequireIndividualApprovalAtOrAbove always needs its own explicit yes. AllowManualOnlyExecution is not honoured: MANUAL-ONLY is refused by the execution engine unconditionally, and the setting exists only so that turning it on and observing nothing change is verifiable.

Safety._comment: CreateRestorePointBeforeHighRisk attempts a System Restore checkpoint before the first HIGH-risk action. System Restore is not a universal undo: it does not restore user files and may be disabled or throttled by Windows.

Reporting._comment: IncludeProcessPaths controls whether executable paths appear in reports. Process command lines are never collected, because they routinely contain credentials and tokens.

Providers._comment: Empty Enabled means every registered provider whose prerequisites are met. Disabled always wins over Enabled.
